newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian PM to meet key party on finance minister.
newsitem.headline: Latvian PM to meet key party on finance minister.

text.p: Latvian Prime Minister Andris Shkele was due to meet leaders of the largest party in the government coalition on Monday after his rejection of its proposal to make Sarmite Jegere the new finance minister.
A spokeswoman for the government press service said Shkele would meet the Democratic Party Saimnieks, the biggest of the six parties in the coalition, in late afternoon,.

Shkele rejected Jegere's candidature last Friday. Jegere, a ministry official in change of investment and credit policy, would have replaced the previous finance minister who was dismissed in October. Shkele has been handling the finance ministry portfolio in the interim.
Newspapers said Democratic Party leader Ziedonis Chevers wanted to find out Shkele's criteria for deciding who should get the finance minister's post.
